Copy one source's target-window bytes to a local file.

gdal_fetch_window.Rd

The fetch half of the fetch/assemble split: a plain gdal_translate -srcwin of the window intersecting ext (plus a warp-kernel margin in source pixels), native dtype and blocks; no warp, no mosaic on the remote path.

Usage

gdal_fetch_window(location, out_file, ext, crs, margin = 8L, out_res = NULL)

Arguments

location

Source path/URL.

out_file

Local destination GTiff.

ext, crs

Target extent and CRS defining the window.

margin

Source-pixel margin around the window.

Value

TRUE, invisibly. Errors if the window is empty or the source unreadable.
